title.zh: 梯度下降 · 摸黑下山
title.en: Gradient Descent · Feeling Your Way Downhill

desc.zh: 训练模型，就是在看不见的地形上摸黑下山：坡度是唯一的信息，步子迈多大决定你走到谷底、原地打转还是飞出去。所有神经网络的训练，剥到底就是这一页的循环。
desc.en: Training a model is feeling your way down a landscape you cannot see: the slope is your only information, and your step size decides whether you reach the bottom, spin in place, or fly off. All of neural-network training, stripped down, is this page's loop.
